# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Left Side:**
  - "Activities" button
  - "Files" button
- **Center:**
  - Date: "Oct 23"
  - Time: "17:45"
  - Notification bell icon
- **Right Side:**
  - Network connectivity icon
  - Sound/volume control icon
  - Power button icon

## Desktop Environment
- **Background:** Geometric abstract wallpaper with gradient from deep purple to red-orange
- **Desktop Icon:**
  - "Home" folder icon located at bottom right corner

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom:**
  - Google Chrome browser icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - Files application icon
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Terminal icon (command line)
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon (application overview)

## Active Windows

### Terminal Window
- **Title Bar:**
  - "user@user-virtual-machine: ~"
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button
- **Window Content:**
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~$"
  - Cursor at end of prompt line
  - Dark purple background

### File Manager Window
- **Title Bar:**
  - "Home / Downloads"
  - Back button
  - Forward button
  - More options button (three dots)
  - Search button
  - View options button (three horizontal lines)
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button
- **Navigation Panel (Left Side):**
  - "Recent" (with clock icon)
  - "Starred" (with star icon)
  - "Home" (with house icon)
  - "Desktop" (with folder icon)
  - "Documents" (with document icon)
  - "Downloads" (with download icon) — currently selected
  - "/home/user/Downloads" (path shown in tooltip)
  - "Music" (with music note icon)
  - "Pictures" (with image icon)
  - "Videos" (with video camera icon)
  - "Trash" (with trash can icon)
  - "Other Locations" (with plus icon)
- **File View (Right Side):**
  - Single file visible: "paywalled_article.html"
  - File icon: HTML document icon (with "<>" symbol)
  - File name: "paywalled_article.html" (with underline)
  - Empty space below the file

## Window Layout
- Terminal window is positioned on the left side of the screen
- File manager window is positioned on the right side of the screen
- Both windows are overlapping slightly, with the file manager window partially covering the terminal window
- File manager window is active and in focus

## Visual Design
- **Color Scheme:**
  - Dark purple for terminal background
  - Light gray for file manager window borders and navigation panel
  - White for file manager content area
  - Red-orange gradient for desktop background
- **Typography:**
  - Clean, sans-serif font for all text elements
  - Consistent font size across interface elements
- **Icons:**
  - Simple, flat design for all icons
  - Icons are monochromatic with slight color accents
- **Spacing:**
  - Ample padding between elements
  - Consistent spacing within windows and panels

## Interface State
- Terminal is idle, awaiting user input
- File manager is displaying the Downloads folder
- File manager is currently focused, as indicated by the highlighted "Downloads" item in the navigation panel
- No other applications are actively running or visible
- System appears to be in a standard, non-interactive state
